+ # Implementation Summary: Website Form Integration
+ 
+ ## Overview
+ 
+ This document provides a concise summary of the implementation plan to merge the website form functionality into the onboarding sequence and trigger SEO analysis.

+ ## Core Changes Required

+ ### 1. In `apps/intentified/src/app/dashboard/onboarding/page.tsx`
+ 
+ Add SEO analysis state and import the server action:
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ import { combinedUrlActions } from "@/features/dashboard/pipelines/seo-digital-processing/lib/actions";
+ 
+ // Add to existing state
+ const [seoAnalysisState, setSeoAnalysisState] = useState({
+   status: 'idle' as 'idle' | 'loading' | 'success' | 'error',
+   results: null as any,
+   error: null as string | null,
+ });
+ 
+ // Add SEO analysis trigger function
+ const triggerSeoAnalysis = async (url: string) => {
+   setSeoAnalysisState({ status: 'loading', results: null, error: null });
+   
+   const formData = new FormData();
+   formData.append('url', url);
+   
+   try {
+     const results = await combinedUrlActions(null, formData);
+     setSeoAnalysisState({ status: 'success', results, error: null });
+     return true;
+   } catch (error) {
+     setSeoAnalysisState({ 
+       status: 'error', 
+       results: null, 
+       error: error.message || 'Failed to analyze website' 
+     });
+     return false;
+   }
+ };
+ 
+ // Pass to OnboardingSequence
+ <OnboardingSequence
+   // ... existing props
+   seoAnalysisState={seoAnalysisState}
+   triggerSeoAnalysis={triggerSeoAnalysis}
+ />
+ ```
+

+ # Website Form Integration - Pseudocode
+ 
+ ## Main Integration Flow
+ 
+ ```pseudocode
+ COMPONENT OnboardingSequence:
+     // State Management
+     STATE:
+         currentStep: string
+         formData: {
+             companyName, companySize, industry, website,
+             socialLinks: { twitter, instagram, linkedin, facebook },
+             goals: []
+         }
+         seoAnalysisState: {
+             isAnalyzing: boolean
+             analysisResults: null | SeoAnalysisData
+             error: null | string
+         }
+         websiteUrlValidation: {
+             isValid: boolean
+             hasInteracted: boolean
+             errorMessage: string
+         }
+ 
+     // Enhanced Input Handler for Website URL
+     FUNCTION handleWebsiteUrlChange(value: string):
+         trimmedValue = value.trim()
+         
+         // Ensure https:// prefix
+         IF NOT trimmedValue.startsWith("https://"):
+             trimmedValue = "https://"
+         
+         // Update form data
+         formData.website = trimmedValue
+         
+         // Validate URL
+         IF websiteUrlValidation.hasInteracted:
+             validationResult = validateUrl(trimmedValue)
+             websiteUrlValidation.isValid = validationResult.success
+             websiteUrlValidation.errorMessage = validationResult.error || ""
+         
+         // Reset SEO analysis if URL changed
+         IF seoAnalysisState.analysisResults AND seoAnalysisState.analysisResults.url != trimmedValue:
+             seoAnalysisState.analysisResults = null
+ 
+     // SEO Analysis Trigger
+     FUNCTION triggerSeoAnalysis():
+         IF NOT websiteUrlValidation.isValid:
+             RETURN false
+         
+         seoAnalysisState.isAnalyzing = true
+         seoAnalysisState.error = null
+         
+         TRY:
+             // Call SEO analysis API/action
+             results = AWAIT analyzeSeoForUrl(formData.website)
+             seoAnalysisState.analysisResults = results
+             seoAnalysisState.isAnalyzing = false
+             RETURN true
+         CATCH error:
+             seoAnalysisState.error = error.message
+             seoAnalysisState.isAnalyzing = false
+             RETURN false
+ 
+     // Enhanced Step Navigation
+     FUNCTION handleStepChange(newStep: string):
+         // Special handling for Digital -> SEO transition
+         IF currentStep == "digital" AND newStep == "seo":
+             // Validate website URL first
+             IF NOT formData.website OR formData.website == "https://":
+                 SHOW_ERROR("Please enter a website URL")
+                 RETURN
+             
+             IF NOT websiteUrlValidation.isValid:
+                 SHOW_ERROR("Please enter a valid website URL")
+                 RETURN
+             
+             // Trigger SEO analysis if not already done
+             IF NOT seoAnalysisState.analysisResults:
+                 success = AWAIT triggerSeoAnalysis()
+                 IF NOT success:
+                     SHOW_ERROR("Failed to analyze website. Please try again.")
+                     RETURN
+         
+         // Allow navigation
+         currentStep = newStep
+ 
+     // Render Logic Updates
+     RENDER:
+         <Tabs value={currentStep} onValueChange={handleStepChange}>
+             // ... other tabs ...
+             
+             // Enhanced Digital Tab
+             <TabsContent value="digital">
+                 <Card>
+                     <CardHeader>...</CardHeader>
+                     <CardContent>
+                         <WebsiteUrlInput
+                             value={formData.website}
+                             onChange={handleWebsiteUrlChange}
+                             isValid={websiteUrlValidation.isValid}
+                             hasError={websiteUrlValidation.hasInteracted AND NOT websiteUrlValidation.isValid}
+                             errorMessage={websiteUrlValidation.errorMessage}
+                             onFocus={() => websiteUrlValidation.hasInteracted = true}
+                         />
+                         
+                         // Social links section...
+                     </CardContent>
+                     <CardFooter>
+                         <Button onClick={() => handleStepChange("goals")}>Previous</Button>
+                         <Button 
+                             onClick={() => handleStepChange("seo")}
+                             disabled={NOT websiteUrlValidation.isValid OR seoAnalysisState.isAnalyzing}
+                         >
+                             {seoAnalysisState.isAnalyzing ? "Analyzing..." : "Analyze Website"}
+                         </Button>
+                     </CardFooter>
+                 </Card>
+             </TabsContent>
+             
+             // Enhanced SEO Tab
+             <TabsContent value="seo">
+                 <Card>
+                     <CardHeader>
+                         <CardTitle>SEO Analysis Results</CardTitle>
+                         <CardDescription>
+                             Analysis for: {formData.website}
+                         </CardDescription>
+                     </CardHeader>
+                     <CardContent>
+                         IF seoAnalysisState.isAnalyzing:
+                             <LoadingSpinner message="Analyzing your website..." />
+                         ELSE IF seoAnalysisState.error:
+                             <ErrorDisplay 
+                                 error={seoAnalysisState.error}
+                                 onRetry={triggerSeoAnalysis}
+                             />
+                         ELSE IF seoAnalysisState.analysisResults:
+                             <SeoAnalysisResults data={seoAnalysisState.analysisResults} />
+                         ELSE:
+                             <EmptyState 
+                                 message="No analysis results yet"
+                                 onAnalyze={triggerSeoAnalysis}
+                             />
+                     </CardContent>
+                     <CardFooter>
+                         <Button onClick={() => handleStepChange("digital")}>Back</Button>
+                         <Button onClick={completeOnboarding}>Complete Setup</Button>
+                     </CardFooter>
+                 </Card>
+             </TabsContent>
+         </Tabs>
+ ```
+ 
+ ## WebsiteUrlInput Component
+ 
+ ```pseudocode
+ COMPONENT WebsiteUrlInput:
+     PROPS:
+         value: string
+         onChange: (value: string) => void
+         isValid: boolean
+         hasError: boolean
+         errorMessage: string
+         onFocus: () => void
+ 
+     STATE:
+         inputRef: HTMLInputElement
+         localValue: string = value
+ 
+     // Initialize
+     ON_MOUNT:
+         // Set cursor position after https://
+         IF inputRef:
+             inputRef.setSelectionRange(8, 8)
+ 
+     // Handle input changes
+     FUNCTION handleChange(event):
+         newValue = event.target.value
+         
+         // Prevent deletion of https://
+         IF newValue.length < 8:
+             newValue = "https://"
+         
+         // Prevent cursor from going before https://
+         cursorPosition = inputRef.selectionStart
+         IF cursorPosition < 8:
+             inputRef.setSelectionRange(8, 8)
+         
+         localValue = newValue
+         onChange(newValue)
+ 
+     RENDER:
+         <div className="space-y-2">
+             <Label htmlFor="website">
+                 <Globe className="h-4 w-4" />
+                 Website URL
+             </Label>
+             <Input
+                 ref={inputRef}
+                 id="website"
+                 type="url"
+                 value={localValue}
+                 onChange={handleChange}
+                 onFocus={onFocus}
+                 placeholder="https://example.com"
+                 className={hasError ? "border-red-500" : ""}
+             />
+             IF hasError AND errorMessage:
+                 <p className="text-red-500 text-sm">{errorMessage}</p>
+         </div>

+ 
+ ## URL Validation Function
+ 
+ ```pseudocode
+ FUNCTION validateUrl(url: string):
+     // Check if URL is just the prefix
+     IF url == "https://":
+         RETURN { success: false, error: "Please enter a complete URL" }
+     
+     // Use regex pattern for validation
+     urlPattern = /^https?:\/\/[^\s$.?#].[^\s]*$/
+     
+     IF NOT urlPattern.test(url):
+         RETURN { success: false, error: "Please enter a valid URL" }
+     
+     // Additional validation
+     TRY:
+         parsedUrl = new URL(url)
+         
+         // Check for valid hostname
+         IF NOT parsedUrl.hostname OR parsedUrl.hostname == "":
+             RETURN { success: false, error: "Invalid hostname" }
+         
+         // Check for common issues
+         IF parsedUrl.hostname.includes(".."):
+             RETURN { success: false, error: "Invalid URL format" }
+         
+         RETURN { success: true }
+     CATCH:
+         RETURN { success: false, error: "Invalid URL format" }
+ ```
+ 
+ ## SEO Analysis Integration
+ 
+ ```pseudocode
+ FUNCTION analyzeSeoForUrl(url: string):
+     // Create form data
+     formData = new FormData()
+     formData.append("url", url)
+     
+     // Call the SEO analysis action
+     response = AWAIT seoAnalysisAction(formData)
+     
+     IF response.error:
+         THROW new Error(response.error)
+     
+     RETURN {
+         url: url,
+         timestamp: Date.now(),
+         rawWebVitals: response.rawWebVitals,
+         allSeoData: response.allSeoData,
+         coreVitalsAssessment: response.coreVitalsAssessment
+     }
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Error Handling States
+ 
+ ```pseudocode
+ COMPONENT ErrorDisplay:
+     PROPS:
+         error: string
+         onRetry: () => void
+ 
+     RENDER:
+         <Alert variant="destructive">
+             <AlertTitle>Analysis Failed</AlertTitle>
+             <AlertDescription>{error}</AlertDescription>
+             <Button onClick={onRetry} className="mt-2">
+                 Try Again
+             </Button>

+ 
+ COMPONENT LoadingSpinner:

+

+             <Spinner className="animate-spin h-8 w-8" />
+             <p className="mt-2 text-muted-foreground">{message}</p>
+         </div>
+ ```

+ # Website Form Integration Documentation
+ 
+ ## Project Overview
+ 
+ This document describes the integration of the sophisticated website form and SEO analysis functionality into the onboarding sequence component. The goal is to trigger SEO analysis when users enter their website URL during onboarding.
+ 
+ ## Key Modules and Components
+ 
+ ### 1. Core Components
+ 
+ #### OnboardingSequence (`onboarding-sequence.tsx`)
+ 
+ - **Current State**: Multi-step onboarding form with tabs
+ - **Enhancement**: Integrate SEO analysis trigger in Digital step
+ - **Key Features**:
+   - Tab-based navigation
+   - Form state management
+   - User metadata updates via Clerk
+ 
+ #### WebsiteFormSection (`website-form.tsx`)
+ 
+ - **Purpose**: Sophisticated URL input with SEO analysis trigger
+ - **Key Features**:
+   - Advanced URL validation with Zod
+   - Auto-prepend "https://" functionality
+   - Cursor position management
+   - Loading states and animations
+   - Integration with `combinedUrlActions` server action
+ 
+ ### 2. Server Actions
+ 
+ #### combinedUrlActions (`lib/actions.ts`)
+ 
+ - **Location**: `apps/intentified/src/features/dashboard/pipelines/seo-digital-processing/lib/actions.ts`
+ - **Purpose**: Main server action for SEO analysis
+ - **Process**:
+   1. Validates URL using Zod schema
+   2. Runs SEO crawling and web vitals analysis in parallel
+   3. Returns comprehensive analysis data
+   4. Handles errors and redirects
+ 
+ ### 3. Process Architecture
+ 
+ ```
+ User Journey:
+ 1. Welcome → 2. Company → 3. Goals → 4. Digital → 5. SEO Analysis
+ 
+ Digital Step Enhancement:
+ - Replace simple URL input with WebsiteUrlInput component
+ - Add validation feedback
+ - Enable "Analyze Website" button when URL is valid
+ 
+ SEO Analysis Trigger:
+ - On navigation from Digital to SEO tab
+ - Validate URL before proceeding
+ - Call combinedUrlActions with URL
+ - Show loading state during analysis
+ - Display results or errors
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 4. Data Flow
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // State Structure
+ {
+   onboardingData: {
+     companyName: string,
+     website: string,
+     socialLinks: {...},
+     goals: []
+   },
+   seoAnalysis: {
+     status: 'idle' | 'loading' | 'success' | 'error',
+     results: {
+       allSeoData: SEOData[],
+       rawWebVitals: WebVitals,
+       coreVitalsAssessment: Assessment,
+       seoFeedback: Feedback,
+       timestamp: string
+     },
+     error: string | null
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // Action Flow
+ 1. User enters URL → State update
+ 2. URL validation → Enable/disable analysis
+ 3. Trigger analysis → Call server action
+ 4. Update state → Show results
+ 5. Complete onboarding → Save all data
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 5. Component Architecture
+ 
+ #### Extracted Components
+ 
+ **WebsiteUrlInput**
+ 
+ - Reusable URL input component
+ - Encapsulates validation logic
+ - Maintains sophisticated UX features
+ 
+ **SeoAnalysisResults**
+ 
+ - Displays SEO analysis data
+ - Integrates existing SEO components
+ - Handles loading and error states
+ 
+ #### Integration Points
+ 
+ 1. **Digital Tab Enhancement**:
+    - Replace existing URL input
+    - Add WebsiteUrlInput component
+    - Connect to parent state
+ 
+ 2. **SEO Tab Implementation**:
+    - Show analysis results
+    - Handle loading states
+    - Provide retry functionality
+ 
+ ### 6. Implementation Details
+ 
+ #### URL Validation
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ const urlPattern = /^https?:\/\/[^\s$.?#].[^\s]*$/;
+ const validateUrl = (url: string) => {
+   if (url === "https://") return false;
+   return urlPattern.test(url);
+ };
+ ```
+ 
+ #### State Management
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // In parent component
+ const [seoAnalysisState, setSeoAnalysisState] = useState({
+   status: 'idle',
+   results: null,
+   error: null
+ });
+ 
+ // Trigger analysis
+ const triggerSeoAnalysis = async (url: string) => {
+   setSeoAnalysisState({ status: 'loading', results: null, error: null });
+   
+   const formData = new FormData();
+   formData.append('url', url);
+   
+   try {
+     const results = await combinedUrlActions(null, formData);
+     setSeoAnalysisState({ status: 'success', results, error: null });
+   } catch (error) {
+     setSeoAnalysisState({ status: 'error', results: null, error: error.message });
+   }
+ };
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 7. Error Handling
+ 
+ 1. **URL Validation Errors**: Inline feedback under input
+ 2. **Network Errors**: Show in SEO tab with retry
+ 3. **Analysis Failures**: Display error with suggestions
+ 4. **Timeout Handling**: 30-second timeout with feedback
+ 
+ ### 8. UI/UX Considerations
+ 
+ 1. **Progressive Enhancement**: Basic functionality works without JavaScript
+ 2. **Loading States**: Clear feedback during analysis
+ 3. **Error Recovery**: Easy retry mechanisms
+ 4. **Smooth Transitions**: Animated tab changes
+ 5. **Mobile Responsive**: Works on all devices
+ 
+ ### 9. Testing Requirements
+ 
+ 1. **Unit Tests**:

+ 
+ 2. **Integration Tests**:
+    - Full onboarding flow
+    - SEO analysis trigger
+    - Error scenarios
+ 
+ 3. **E2E Tests**:
+    - Complete user journey
+    - Real API calls
+    - Performance metrics
+ 
+ ### 10. Deployment Considerations
+ 
+ 1. **Environment Variables**: Ensure API endpoints are configured
+ 2. **Rate Limiting**: Handle API rate limits gracefully
+ 3. **Caching**: Consider caching SEO results
+ 4. **Monitoring**: Track analysis success/failure rates
+ 
+ ## Summary
+ 
+ This integration enhances the onboarding experience by:
+ 
+ 1. Providing sophisticated URL input with validation
+ 2. Seamlessly triggering SEO analysis during onboarding
+ 3. Displaying comprehensive SEO insights
+ 4. Maintaining smooth user experience with proper error handling
+ 
+ The implementation leverages existing components while adding new functionality, ensuring code reusability and maintainability.
